note: Price anchors for catalog items the ledgers never show, transcribed from wayfinder/research/02-cost-facts.md (ticket 02 fact sheet). `txns author` checks these first: a drafted item whose id or text contains one of an entry's keywords (whole words, any case, '-' and spaces alike) takes its prices from the entry. An entry without `unit_prices` (the fact sheet found no price) leaves a matching item out of the bundle and lists it in author's report: add a sourced price here to bring it in. Entries are tried in order, so put specific keywords first. Money is int centavos per rate-card unit (per pack when `pack_pcs` is set), the D-calc figures to the peso: a whole ₱1,000 would be a plug-row tell on a retail item. PHP figures from US list prices use the BSP 2025 average of PHP 57.51 per US$ (fact sheet section 2.1).
